release_commit_note: The release commit is recorded by Git history; embedding the containing commit would create a self-referential hash.
summary: Added a collapsed-card discoverability badge for Related News: any source-register record whose optional `news` array (populated by the news-aggregator role) is non-empty now shows a small "News" badge (with an item count when more than one) in its collapsed card header, alongside the existing source-type/status/AEC/confidence badges. Fixes a discoverability gap in the v1.2.0 Related News feature: the news block itself only renders inside the expanded card body, so a reader browsing a mostly-collapsed source register had no way to tell which records carried news without expanding every card individually. No change to the news block's own structure, position (still after the four AI-perspective panels, before Research Notes), or hide-when-empty behavior. agents/roles/web-ux-ui-editor.md bumped to 1.3.0 to document the new badge requirement.
